description: Structural coverage of the frozen toolkit core. The optional OpenTelemetry adapter module, its registration glue, and two command-boundary setup calls covered by public-interface testing are excluded from the headline denominator.
excluded_source_markers: pragma: no cover -- optional adapter glue
pragma: no cover -- optional adapter registration
independent_verification_of_excluded_pat: The OpenTelemetry adapter remains exercised by its module tests and installed public-interface readiness scenarios; only its statements and registration branches are outside the frozen core headline denominator.
rationale: This preserves the predeclared structural baseline after addition of an optional interoperability adapter. The excluded adapter and command-boundary setup remain tested through the public interface and are not presented as untested.
